sources.text: I own two cats. One is named Rook and the other is named Ash. Rook and Ash are different individuals, not two names for one cat.
One of my cats might have been recorded with the wrong name. Perhaps it should be Finn, but I cannot remember which cat or whether this is true. Do not change either name until I clarify.
I think the operator's cat recorded as Rook should actually be named Moss. I want to correct the stored name from Rook to Moss, although the operator has not supplied or confirmed that correction.
